en.text: Import and export Results from CI, cases from spreadsheets, the group exported as a file. pnpm tests does the same from the command line. Format JUnit XML Playwright JSON Allure Environment Not set Local File in the project Path from the project root: test-results/junit.xml Take from the project Pick a file Cases into the group “smoke” A table from another system: columns are read from the headers.
